manifest_status: source inventory and execution contract; not a claim that full results reproduce on every machine

validation.expected: four scores match within 1e-12 and three fixture facts survive in the declared order

experiments.output_contract: exp1_tkg_decay.json/csv and exp1b_decay_alternatives.json/csv; metric values must be finite in [0,1] and query counts positive
experiments.tolerance: 1e-9 absolute for repeated runs with the same input bytes, Python/NumPy lock, and CPU execution
experiments.limitations: Full execution is compute-intensive; upstream license must be reviewed before redistribution.

experiments.output_contract: exp2_stl_time_<subset>.json; counts are non-negative and reported probabilities/AUROC values, when defined, are in [0,1]
experiments.limitations: Requires a user-supplied API credential, network access, and paid or quota-limited remote inference. Provider behavior is not revision-pinned or deterministic.

experiments.output_contract: exp3_beta_sensitivity.json and exp3_beta_heatmap.csv; all reported retrieval metrics are finite in [0,1]
experiments.tolerance: 1e-9 absolute with identical input bytes and locked environment
experiments.limitations: ICEWS relation groups are research proxies, not validated domain half-lives.

experiments.output_contract: exp3b_clinical_beta.json and exp3b_clinical_heatmap.csv; metrics are finite in [0,1] and category counts are non-negative
experiments.tolerance: 1e-9 absolute with verified demo files and the locked environment
experiments.limitations: Uses only the deidentified open demo. It is research code, not clinical validation, clinical advice, or a medical-device claim; raw records remain ignored.

experiments.output_contract: exp3c_clinical_ablations.json; metric values are finite in [0,1], and the declared beta and decay-model parameter sweeps are present
experiments.tolerance: 1e-9 absolute with verified demo files and the locked environment
experiments.limitations: Same clinical and data-handling limits as exp3b; the run can be expensive.

experiments.output_contract: exp4_gdelt_decay.json; metric values are finite in [0,1], relation identifiers are preserved, and query counts are positive
experiments.tolerance: 1e-9 absolute with the pinned dataset revision and locked environment
experiments.limitations: The complete sweep downloads a large dataset and is compute-intensive.

experiments.output_contract: exp5_sweep.json and exp5_rag_endtoend.json; retrieval/accuracy metrics are finite in [0,1] and every evaluated item retains its method/config metadata
experiments.tolerance: schema/range only for remote-LLM output; 1e-6 absolute for embedding-based metrics on the same hardware/software stack
experiments.limitations: Embedding caches are machine artifacts. GPU kernels may vary, and remote inference requires credentials and is not deterministically versioned.

experiments.output_contract: exp6_ablation.json; every ablation variant and configured temporal dimension is present and Gold@k values are finite in [0,1]
experiments.tolerance: 1e-6 absolute with the same verified embedding-cache checksum and software/hardware stack
experiments.limitations: Requires the ignored embedding cache produced by exp5; its checksum must be recorded in each released result bundle.
